name: Xfinity (Comcast) Internet
why: Largest U.S. broadband provider (~31.5M customers per catalog); national brand with its own xfinity.com billing.

name: Spectrum Internet (Charter)
why: Second-largest U.S. ISP (~29.7M internet customers); distinct spectrum.net billing.

name: AT&T Internet / AT&T Fiber
why: Largest telco ISP (~14.5M broadband customers, ~10M fiber); myAT&T billing.

name: Verizon Fios & Verizon Home Internet
why: ~10M Fios + fixed-wireless home internet customers; My Verizon billing.

name: T-Mobile Home Internet
why: Largest fixed-wireless ISP (~7M); billed on the T-Mobile account (T-Life / My T-Mobile).

name: Cox Communications (Cox Internet)
why: ~5.5M customers; still bills in Cox My Account on cox.com while joining Spectrum (separate billing site today).

name: Optimum (Altice USA)
why: ~4.1M customers in the NY metro and former Suddenlink areas; optimum.net billing.

name: Frontier (Frontier Fiber / Internet)
why: ~3M customers, major fiber builder; now Verizon-owned but billed on frontier.com.

name: Starlink
why: Best-known satellite ISP (~2M U.S. subscribers); subscription billing in the Starlink account.

name: Brightspeed
why: ~1.5M customers in former CenturyLink ILEC territory across 20 states; My Brightspeed billing.

name: Mediacom (Mediacom Xtream)
why: ~1.4M customers; largest cable ISP in small Midwest/South markets; bills in Mediacom Customer Support (Mediacom ID).

name: Kinetic by Windstream
why: ~1.1M customers in 18 states; Go Kinetic portal billing.

name: Sparklight (Cable One)
why: ~1M customers in 24 states; own Sparklight online account with Quick Pay.

name: Quantum Fiber
why: ~1M fiber customers (now Quantum Fiber from AT&T, still billed on quantumfiber.com, separate from myAT&T); prepaid automatic billing.

name: Astound Broadband
why: ~1M customers (RCN, Wave, Grande, enTouch); MyAstound billing.

name: Metronet
why: ~1M fiber customers in 16 states (T-Mobile/KKR JV); myMetronet portal and Quick Pay.

name: Consolidated Communications / Fidium Fiber
why: ~900K customers (northern New England and more); regional portals plus one-time pay site.

name: HughesNet
why: ~800K satellite subscribers nationwide; myHughesnet billing with Pay Now.

name: Breezeline
why: ~650K customers in 13 eastern states; Breezeline My Account billing.

name: altafiber (Fioptics)
why: ~600K customers in Greater Cincinnati; My altafiber Account billing.
